_metadata.has_roof_description: Binary indicator (1 = retractable/dome roof, 0 = open-air). Weather effects are dampened by roof_dampening_factor for roofed stadiums.

performance_notes.interpretation: Model explains ~4% of strikeout variance and ~2% of run variance from weather. Use for directional effects only (will weather increase/decrease K or R), not precise predictions.

fixed_effects_interpretation.temp_f: Per 1 SD (16.3F) increase in temp, strikeouts decrease by ~0.08. Hotter = fewer K.
fixed_effects_interpretation.wspd_mph: Per 1 SD (4.7 mph) increase in wind speed, strikeouts increase by ~0.04.
fixed_effects_interpretation.wind_cf: Wind blowing out to CF has minimal effect on strikeouts.
fixed_effects_interpretation.is_night: Night games have ~0.27 fewer strikeouts than day games.

fixed_effects_interpretation.temp_f: Per 1 SD (16.3F) increase in temp, runs increase by ~0.20. Hotter = more runs.
fixed_effects_interpretation.wspd_mph: Per 1 SD (4.7 mph) increase in wind speed, runs increase by ~0.09.
fixed_effects_interpretation.wind_cf: Wind blowing out to CF increases runs by ~0.09 per SD.
fixed_effects_interpretation.is_night: Night games have ~0.12 more runs than day games.
